# AI-ROUTER

Use `ai-router/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "ai-router-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "ai-router/gpt-5.4",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `AI_ROUTER_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.ai-router.dev/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `AI_ROUTER_BASE_URL`.

- https://ai-router.dev/openai-compatible-api-gateway/
